steps.prompt: IMPORTANT LAYOUT: exactly 4 columns x 6 rows of equal cells. Create an image. Pixel art game VFX sprite sheet. The attached image is the LEVEL-2 version of a skill effect sheet of Mộc Lộc (wood). Redraw it as the LEGENDARY (final mythic tier) version, FRAME FOR FRAME: a grid of 4 columns x 6 rows, same order, every frame shows the same moment as the attached frame in the same cell, facing right, same pixel art style with a dark outline. Canvas portrait 2:3. Flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines, no borders). Each effect stays inside its own cell with a clear magenta gap on every side and must not touch its neighbours. Legendary rules: it must look DIVINE and GODLIKE, clearly a tier above the attached level-2 version, like the final transformation super move of an anime boss. Keep the same timing but make every frame SPECTACULAR and full of motion: MASSIVE THUNDER - huge thick jagged lightning bolts striking down and forking around the effect in every frame (a different bolt shape each frame so it flickers when animated), electric arcs crackling across it; ROARING FLAMES - big swirling tongues of blazing fire and energy flames (green-gold spirit flames with flying petals) trailing and licking off every shape, flowing in the direction of motion; plus radiant WHITE-GOLD divine light at the core, a glowing golden RUNE CIRCLE or halo ring behind the big moments, a sacred world-tree motif, glowing golden leaves and blossoms, bright light rays bursting outward, sharp shockwave rings, swirling energy spirals and strong rim light. Keep the green, lime, pink blossoms colours as the base and add radiant gold and a soft prismatic shine so it reads as LEGENDARY. Big bold shapes with thick outlines and flat colour blocks, NOT tiny scattered particles or sparkle noise. The effect can fill more of its cell than level 2 but still tapers off and ENDS inside the cell. This sheet: skill 4 (ultimate) - level 2 was: Divine deer bigger with golden glowing antlers; wider summon and flower rings. LAYOUT OF THIS ONE IMAGE: rows alternate. Odd rows (1, 3, 5...) are the legendary frames: row 1 = row 1 of the attached sheet, row 3 = its row 2, row 5 = its row 3, frame for frame, same order. Each EVEN row, right under a frame row, holds the IN-BETWEEN frames for smoother animation: the cell under a frame is the moment exactly HALFWAY between that frame and the NEXT frame, a new drawing halfway in size, position and lightning shape, not a copy. The 12 frames are ONE sequence read left to right, top to bottom: cell n = halfway from frame n to frame n+1 (cell 4 -> 5, cell 8 -> 9), cell 12 = frame 12 fading out a bit further. All cells the same size, every effect fully inside its own cell with a magenta gap, same place in its cell as the frame above it.
